boundary: Synthetic public examples only. Do not add private logs, connector exports, credentials, local paths, or personal data.

journeys.name: Plan work or set rules
journeys.description: Define an AI-assisted task, private workspace, or coding-agent instructions before work begins.

journeys.name: Check boundaries or evidence
journeys.description: Check publication safety, evidence scope, model output, or action authority and leave inspectable proof.

journeys.name: Test or run a workflow
journeys.description: Exercise repeatable QA, evaluation, telemetry, generated systems, or deterministic state.

maturity_definitions.flagship: The most complete public implementation in the toolkit, with a documented integration surface.
maturity_definitions.stable: A focused example with deterministic checks and a deliberately narrow public contract.
maturity_definitions.experimental: A tested teaching pattern whose contract may still change as outside use reveals better boundaries.

repos.name: Agent Operator Handbook
repos.problem_label: Turn an idea or recurring job into bounded, reviewable work
repos.use_when: Turn an idea or recurring job into bounded, reviewable work.
repos.proof: The starter bundle contains the declared source, authority, review, and handoff files and passes its structural checks.
repos.limitation: Guidance and templates do not enforce permissions or verify a live project.
repos.no_code_first_action: Read the five-minute operator loop and use its short brief to define your next AI-assisted task.

repos.name: Reliable AI Work Starter
repos.problem_label: Set up a private AI-work folder with clear sources, permissions, review, and handoff state
repos.use_when: Set up a private AI-work folder with clear sources, permissions, review, and handoff state.
repos.proof: The declared starter files, setup boundary, template links, and public-safety text pass deterministic structural checks.
repos.limitation: The starter does not run an agent, enforce permissions, inspect sources, or prove that a live workflow is useful.
repos.operation: Edits three named local files after approval
repos.no_code_first_action: Preview the template README and its three starter files before deciding whether to create a private copy.

repos.name: Codex Project Instructions Starter
repos.problem_label: Give a coding agent clear project rules before it starts
repos.use_when: Give a coding agent clear project rules before it starts.
repos.proof: The required instruction templates and examples are present and structurally valid.
repos.limitation: Written instructions guide behavior but do not technically enforce it.
repos.no_code_first_action: Open the README and choose the smallest instruction template that fits your repository.

repos.name: Public Repo Safety Kit
repos.problem_label: Check a repository for publication risks before making it public
repos.use_when: Check a repository for publication risks before making it public.
repos.proof: The ordinary scan checks the supplied tree; Git-aware mode checks tracked and nonignored untracked candidates plus reachable commit author and committer email identities.
repos.limitation: It does not scan historical file contents, replace a dedicated secret scanner or manual review, or grant permission to publish.
repos.operation: Read-only check; examples may use temporary files

repos.name: Earned Confidence
repos.problem_label: Record available evidence, remaining uncertainty, and what was known when a decision was made
repos.use_when: Record available evidence, remaining uncertainty, and what was known when a decision was made.
repos.proof: Type checking, behavioral tests, and the synthetic example preserve unknown state, evidence-key isolation, policy-defined bands, immutable snapshots, and deterministic serialization.
repos.limitation: Observations are not authenticated, bands are not statistical, and the package supplies no persistence or authorization.
repos.operation: Read-only check; examples may use temporary files

repos.name: EvidenceGate
repos.problem_label: Create a compact review receipt for AI-assisted work
repos.use_when: Create a compact review receipt for AI-assisted work.
repos.proof: Declared claims, checks, changed paths, review, and public-safety fields are tied to the exact Git revision supplied to the verifier.
repos.limitation: It does not authenticate a reviewer, prove semantic correctness, or approve publication.
repos.operation: Read-only check; examples may use temporary files

repos.name: Local Model Reliability Example
repos.problem_label: Prevent an ungrounded web answer from entering trusted agent context
repos.use_when: Prevent an ungrounded web answer from entering trusted agent context.
repos.proof: The frozen synthetic cases accept only the source-bound answer and reject missing or unapproved citations, unsupported release facts, false metadata, hostile echoes, raw source content, and malformed shapes before downstream context is allowed.
repos.limitation: The gate calls no model or network, covers only the declared software-release fact profile and canaries, and does not establish source truth, general semantic correctness, live-model quality, or external adoption.
repos.operation: Read-only check; examples may use temporary files

repos.name: Context Boundary Examples
repos.problem_label: Check that an answer stays within the evidence you supplied
repos.use_when: Check that an answer stays within the evidence you supplied.
repos.proof: Expected answers cite only allowed sources and known unsupported or uncited outputs fail.
repos.limitation: Grounding to supplied snippets does not establish that those snippets are true or current.
repos.operation: Read-only check; examples may use temporary files

repos.name: Agent Action Authority Examples
repos.problem_label: Classify a model or agent action before allowing it to run
repos.use_when: Classify a model or agent action before allowing it to run.
repos.proof: Synthetic actions and scoped grants receive the expected allow, reject, or reapproval decisions.
repos.limitation: The classifier does not execute actions, provide a sandbox, or infer security-relevant scope.
repos.operation: Read-only check; examples may use temporary files

repos.name: Agent Evidence Catalog
repos.problem_label: Compare exact agent versions, authority boundaries, publisher claims, and known gaps
repos.use_when: Compare exact agent versions, authority boundaries, publisher claims, and known gaps.
repos.proof: The synthetic catalog validates its exact-version profiles and receipts and rejects deliberate version, arithmetic, and unsupported-verification errors.
repos.limitation: The check does not fetch publisher sources, run agents, verify live behavior, rank products, or establish suitability.
repos.operation: Read-only check; examples may use temporary files

repos.name: Green-Spine QA Pattern
repos.problem_label: Keep one important automated workflow visibly healthy
repos.use_when: Keep one important automated workflow visibly healthy.
repos.proof: One representative synthetic path and its known-bad cases satisfy the named checkpoint.
repos.limitation: A green spine deliberately does not prove every feature, path, or experience quality.
repos.operation: Read-only check; examples may use temporary files

repos.name: Context Contract Compiler
repos.problem_label: Build only the allowed context for an AI task and detect when a late change makes it stale
repos.use_when: Build only the allowed context for an AI task and detect when a late change makes it stale.
repos.proof: The synthetic compiler protects required records before ranking, explains every inclusion and exclusion, fails closed on invalid obligations, and rejects stale receipts deterministically.
repos.limitation: Structured metadata and changes are supplied; the project does not discover runtime changes, authorize actions, verify truth, or prove downstream model safety.
repos.operation: Read-only check; examples may use temporary files

repos.name: Sealed Evaluation Pattern
repos.problem_label: Keep evaluation answers hidden until scoring and retire calibration material after it is revealed
repos.use_when: Keep evaluation answers hidden until scoring and retire calibration material after it is revealed.
repos.proof: The supplied record preserves the declared information zones, freeze order, digests, and retirement rule.
repos.limitation: The checker is not a sandbox and cannot prove an access log is complete or authentic.
repos.operation: Read-only check; examples may use temporary files

repos.name: Generated-System QA Pattern
repos.problem_label: Check generated data, required services, reachable content, and one representative user journey
repos.use_when: Check generated data, required services, reachable content, and one representative user journey.
repos.proof: The supplied artifact matches its blueprint and satisfies the declared structural and journey requirements.
repos.limitation: Structural readiness does not prove live UI freshness, domain quality, accessibility, or enjoyment.
repos.operation: Read-only check; examples may use temporary files

repos.name: Model Workload Telemetry
repos.problem_label: Compare models on the same task while preserving provenance for every run
repos.use_when: Compare models on the same task while preserving provenance for every run.
repos.proof: The declared synthetic shared-task, receipt, and Phase 3 provenance checks pass.
repos.limitation: The checks do not prove live-routing safety, production reliability, causal model superiority, cost efficiency, or statistical significance.
repos.operation: Read-only check; examples may use temporary files

repos.name: AI Game State Machine Pattern
repos.problem_label: Keep valid actions and unresolved obligations consistent when an AI game is saved and replayed
repos.use_when: Keep valid actions and unresolved obligations consistent when an AI game is saved and replayed.
repos.proof: Illegal actions remain non-mutating, inspection is read-only, obligations persist, and seeded replay is deterministic.
repos.limitation: State-machine correctness does not prove that the game is understandable, balanced, emotional, or fun.
repos.operation: Read-only check; examples may use temporary files
